primary_pr.body:
## Summary

Add an explicit `user` or `developer` role to `thread/realtime/appendText` and propagate it through the realtime input queue into `conversation.item.create`. Older JSON clients that omit the field continue to default to `user`.

This lets app-provided context such as memory retain developer authority without bypassing app-server through a renderer-owned data channel. The app-server schemas, API documentation, and focused protocol and websocket coverage are updated with the new contract.

The Codex Apps consumer is tracked in [openai/openai#1025261](https://github.com/openai/openai/pull/1025261).
